First, 49 weeks and 7 days = 49 weeks + 1 week = 50 weeks.  
50 weeks = 50 × 7 = 350 days.  
Subtract 350 days from 1618-09-22.  

1618 is not a leap year (divisible by 4 but not by 400, so not leap in Gregorian proleptic).  
From 1618-09-22 back 350 days:  
Go back 22 days to 1618-08-31 (September has 30 days, so 22 days back from 22nd → Aug 31).  
Remaining days: 350 − 22 = 328 days to go back further.  

From 1618-08-31, go back through August (31 days in Aug):  
328 − 31 = 297 days left, now in July 1618.  
Go back month by month in 1618:  
July 31 days → 297 − 31 = 266  
June 30 → 266 − 30 = 236  
May 31 → 236 − 31 = 205  
April 30 → 205 − 30 = 175  
March 31 → 175 − 31 = 144  
February 28 (1618 not leap) → 144 − 28 = 116  
January 31 → 116 − 31 = 85 days left, now in December 1617.  

December 1617 has 31 days: 85 − 31 = 54 left, now in November 1617.  
November 30: 54 − 30 = 24 left, now in October 1617.  
October 31: but we only need 24 days back from November 1, so go back 24 days into October:  
November 1 minus 1 day = Oct 31, minus 23 more days = Oct 8.  

Thus final date: 1617-10-08.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1617-10-08
